config.name: Babylonian Administrative and Legal Texts
config.blurb: BALT contains Babylonian administrative and legal texts from the Neo-Babylonian, Persian, and Hellenistic periods. These texts give a picture of the administration and daily economic activities at ancient Babylonian cult centers and private households. The project is based at the Centre of Excellence in Ancient Near Eastern Empires, University of Helsinki.
